CLAP_EXT_DRAFT_WEBVIEW_TERMS.doc: The identifiers of the CLAP header clap/ext/draft/webview.h (clap 1.2.10), each mapped under its own name with its status for us (docs/data-layout.md).

webview.ruling: The console draws every panel: no plugin UI runs in the console (GUI ruling 2026-10-19; native windows only in the standalone omx-clap-host, FreeMixer/omx-clap-core#180).

webview/3.ruling: A plugin's own UI, as `gui` (GUI ruling 2026-10-19) (omx-clap-core doc/reference.md, FreeMixer/omx-clap-core#95).
